# Medisca

> Medisca is a pharmaceutical supplier specializing in bulk ingredients, compounding bases, and custom formulation services for pharmacies and healthcare professionals.

Medisca offers a comprehensive catalog of USP/NF-grade pharmaceutical ingredients, excipients, and proprietary compounding bases like AlpaWash®, NovaFilm™, and PLO Gel MediFlo™. The company serves compounding pharmacies, healthcare professionals, and personalized medicine practitioners with both standard bulk chemicals and specialized formulation products.

## Key Topics

- USP/NF Standards
- Pharmaceutical Ingredients
- Compounding Supplies
- Bulk Powders

- Transdermal Delivery
- FDA Compliance

- Healthcare Professionals
- Pharmaceutical Supplier

## Proprietary Compounding Bases

- [AlpaWash® | Ointments | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/alpawash): AlpaWash® water-washable PEG ointment base for pharmaceutical compounding formulations.
- [NovaFilm™ Gel Base | Gels | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/novafilm-gel-base): NovaFilm™ mucoadhesive gel base for transmucosal drug delivery and compounding.
- [PLO Gel MediFlo™ 30 Pre-Mixed | Gels | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/plo-gel-mediflo-30-pre-mixed): PLO Gel MediFlo™ 30 pre-mixed transdermal compounding base with Lipmax® and Pluronic.

## Pharmaceutical Equipment & Dispensers

- [MD® Syringe | Topical Dispensers | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/md-syringe): MD® Syringe topical dispenser product with airless metered-dose pharmaceutical equipment.
- [BD® PhaSeal™ Y-Site Connector C80, Sterile](https://www.medisca.com/products/bd-phaseal-y-site-connector-c80-sterile): BD PhaSeal Y-Site Connector C80 closed-system transfer device for hazardous drug safety.

## Bulk Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Excipients

- [Creatine (Monohydrate) (Dietary Supplement Grade) | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/creatine-monohydrate-dietary-supplement-grade): Creatine Monohydrate dietary supplement grade bulk powder with chemical specifications.
- [Azelaic Acid (Cosmetic Grade) | Non-API | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/azelaic-acid-cosmetic-grade): Azelaic Acid cosmetic-grade skincare ingredient for pharmaceutical and cosmetic use.
- [Lactose NF (Monohydrate) (Spray Dried) | Excipient](https://www.medisca.com/products/lactose-nf-monohydrate-spray-dried): Lactose NF spray-dried excipient for pharmaceutical compounding and formulations.
- [Aspartame, NF | Excipient | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/aspartame-nf): Aspartame NF pharmaceutical excipient powder for compounding and formulation supplies.
- [Acetylcysteine, USP (N-Acetyl-L-Cysteine) (Dietary Supplement Grade) | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/acetylcysteine-usp-n-acetyl-l-cysteine-dietary-supplement-grade): Acetylcysteine USP NAC dietary supplement grade powder bulk ingredient.

## Chemical Reagents & Specialty Ingredients

- [FD and C Red No. 3, Erythrosine, Powder | Colors](https://www.medisca.com/products/fd-and-c-red-no-3-erythrosine-powder): FD&C Red No. 3 Erythrosine powder pharmaceutical coloring ingredient with specifications.
- [Ferric Subsulfate USP (Monsels Solution) | Non-API](https://www.medisca.com/products/ferric-subsulfate-usp-monsels-solution): Ferric Subsulfate USP Monsels Solution pharmaceutical chemical ingredient in bulk.
- [Potassium Chloride USP | Non-API | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/potassium-chloride-usp): Potassium Chloride USP bulk chemical pharmaceutical ingredient with specifications.
- [Isopropyl Alcohol 70% | Reagent | Medisca](https://www.medisca.com/products/isopropyl-alcohol-70): Isopropyl Alcohol 70% laboratory reagent and industrial solvent for pharmaceutical use.
